question.text:
A computer system has $12$ tape drives (reusable resources). There are $n$ processes competing for these resources. Each process may require a maximum of $5$ tape drives to complete its execution.

The maximum value of $n$ for which the system can guarantee to be deadlock-free is:
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
$\text { The following C program is executed on a Unix/Linux system: }$
 

#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main()
{
    //Note the use of the logical AND operator (&&)
    if(fork() && fork()) {
        fork();
    }
    printf("GATE\n");
    return 0;
}


$\text { The total number of times the word}$ "GATE" $\text {is printed is: }$

 

  1. $3$
     
  2. $4$
     
  3. $6$
     
  4. $8$
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
The following C program is executed on a Unix/Linux system:

#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
int main()
{
    int i;
    int n = 10; // n can be any positive integer
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i % 2 != 0) {
            fork();
        }
    }
    return 0;
}


Determine the total number of processes (including the original parent process) created when the program finishes the loop.

  1. $2^n$
     
  2. $2^{n / 2}$
     
  3. $2^{\lfloor n / 2\rfloor}$
     
  4. $2^{[n / 2]}$
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
Consider a disk system with $200$ cylinders, numbered $0$ to $199$ . The requests to access the cylinders occur in the following sequence:

$$
82,170,43,140,24,16,190
$$


Assuming the head is currently at cylinder $50$ and is initially moving towards the higher cylinder numbers (the $199$ end), what is the total head movement required to satisfy all requests using the SCAN disk scheduling policy?
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
Consider a disk system with $200$ cylinders. The requests to access the cylinders occur in the following sequence:

$$
55,58,39,18,90,160,150,38,184
$$


Assuming that the head is currently at cylinder $100$, what is the time taken to satisfy all requests if it takes $1 ~\text{ms}$ to move from one cylinder to an adjacent one and the Shortest Seek Time First (SSTF) policy is used?

  1. $240 ~\text{ms}$
     
  2. $248 ~\text{ms}$
     
  3. $256 ~\text{ms}$
     
  4. $235 ~\text{ms}$
question.subject: Operating System
